question: In April 2023, Government of India launched Vibrant Village Programme from Kibithoo village which is located in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government of India launched the Vibrant Village Programme in April 2023.
 
• The programme was initiated from Kibithoo village.
 
• Kibithoo village is located in the state of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• The Vibrant Village Programme aims to promote the development of border villages to enhance the quality of life for residents.
 
• This initiative is part of the government's effort to ensure inclusive growth and development in remote and border areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is located in the northeastern part of India and shares international borders with China, Bhutan, and Myanmar.
 
• The state is known for its diverse culture, scenic beauty, and strategic importance due to its location.
 
• The Vibrant Village Programme is one of several initiatives aimed at strengthening infrastructure and improving livelihoods in border areas.
 
• This programme includes the development of roads, housing, tourism, and other essential services.
